text.p: Lebanese police seized on Wednesday two trucks loaded with weapons and arrested three Lebanese men, security sources said.

The trucks -- driving in Mayfouq valley 50 km (30 miles) northeast of Beirut -- were loaded with 16 heavy and 40 light machineguns, 100 pistols, land mines, anti-tanks rocket launchers, automatic parts of anti-aircraft guns and different kinds of ammunition, the sources added.
It was not immediately known where the trucks were heading.
The two drivers and a third man accompanying them were immediately arrested, the sources added without naming them.
